name: iq-platform
description: Intelligent Question Bank — dev orchestration for the four services that make up the platform.
//: The portal and the proctored exam module are separate apps on separate ports. Starting only some of them is the usual cause of 'Start Test' landing on ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED, so `npm run dev` starts all four.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix exam/backend install && npm --prefix exam/frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix exam/backend test && npm --prefix frontend exec vitest run
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix exam/backend run build && npm --prefix exam/frontend run build
